problem_statement: Build a brand-new /guides page from scratch on the Stellar Astro docs site. The route /guides does not exist yet (baseline 404/empty). Construct the full page reusing the site's shared chrome (the fixed Nav with the Stellar logo + Search) and its design system (Karla font, neutral light/dark palette, rounded-base outlines, radial gradient background). The page must contain: a 'Guides' hero heading with an intro paragraph; a 'Popular topics' section of three linked topic cards (Introduction, Getting started, Deploying); and a 'Frequently asked questions' section rendered as a data-driven list of native <details>/<summary> collapsible items. Each FAQ summary shows the question; clicking a summary expands it to reveal an answer paragraph plus a 'Read the ... guide' link, and clicking again collapses it (aria/open toggle). The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow at 390px, and the shared Nav chrome must be present and consistent on both /guides and the existing home page.
required_content: Guides hero h1 + intro paragraph mentioning step-by-step guides (e.g. 'Practical, step-by-step guides to help you get the most out of Stellar.')
Popular topics h2 with 3 linked topic cards (Introduction / Getting started / Deploying), each an h3 title + blurb
FAQ list rendered as native <details>/<summary> collapsible items (data-driven from a topics array)

the FAQ questions rendered verbatim as the summary h3, in this order: 'How do I deploy my Stellar site?', 'How do I configure the sidebar?', 'How do I write new documentation pages?', 'How do I customize the theme colors?', 'Does Stellar support multiple languages?'
each FAQ summary shows the question as an h3; expanding reveals an answer paragraph + a 'Read the ... guide' link
the 'How do I deploy my Stellar site?' answer paragraph reads: 'Run npm run build, then upload the dist folder to Netlify, Vercel, or any static host. No server is required.'
collapsible toggle: click summary expands (details[open]) revealing answer text; click again collapses
shared fixed Nav chrome (Stellar logo h2 + Search button) present on /guides
cross-page consistency: same Nav chrome present on the existing home page
responsive layout: no horizontal overflow at 390px (topic grid collapses to single column)
design_constraints: reuse the shared Base.astro layout + Nav.astro (fixed top nav, backdrop blur, Stellar logo, Search)
Karla font, neutral-100/neutral-950 light/dark backgrounds, radial-gradient background image
rounded-base (10px) corners, black/20 & white/20 outlines, hover:bg-black/10 hover states
use the site's existing text tokens (text-lightModeText / dark:text-darkModeText) and opacity-based secondary text

light-mode palette anchors from the reference render: page background neutral-100 rgb(245,245,245) / #f5f5f5 with a lavender radial gradient (#e2e1ed, #cecee0), body text black rgb(0,0,0), card outlines rgba(0,0,0,0.2); overall mean background ~ #e7e7ee
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /guides (near-empty stub, no Base layout, SSG emits empty dist/guides/index.html #18k); reference 完整实现 collapsible FAQ + topic cards + shared Nav; bad = reference + sabotage <script> that reverts every details 'open' toggle so the collapsible never stays expanded -> fails ONLY interaction_assertions. Shared infra fix (all 3 workspaces): Nav.astro + MobileNav.astro coerce a non-language top-level segment (e.g. 'guides') to 'en' so getDocs()/Search never crash. T3 consistency = shared Nav chrome (Stellar logo h2 + Search button) bound as dom_assertions on BOTH desktop_guides AND desktop_home (#18ag). 三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。
